page_title: NAP 1-0 UDI | Napoli v Udinese 24/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The match has just finished.
90+3' The resulting corner from Lennon Miller (Udinese) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
90+2' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) is caught offside once again.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
90' Lennon Miller (Udinese) receives a yellow card.
89' That's unlucky! Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
89' Maduka Okoye steps in and intercepts a long pass from Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli).

85' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant low pass, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem. That should have been a goalscoring opportunity.
84' Miguel Gutierrez (Napoli) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
81' A yellow card for a tackle by Adam Buksa (Udinese). Andrea Zanotti doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
80' Today's match ends for Jordan Zemura who will be replaced by Branimir Mlacic (Udinese).
80' Substitution. Oier Zarraga (Udinese) in, Keinan Davis out.
80' Antonio Conte prepares a substitution. Alex Meret is replaced by Nikita Contini (Napoli).
80' That's the end of the game for Matteo Politano, who is replaced by Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli).
77' Miguel Gutierrez (Napoli) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his low drive to the middle of the goal is smartly dealt with by Maduka Okoye.
75' Matteo Politano (Napoli) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards the bottom right corner, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Maduka Okoye.
72' A precise short pass from Rasmus Hojlund releases Scott McTominay (Napoli) in space inside the box, but he smashes a wild shot high over the bar.
71' Idrissa Gueye (Udinese) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
70' Lennon Miller (Udinese) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
70' Idrissa Gueye (Udinese) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender. Good work from Udinese as they win a corner.
69' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) offside.
69' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) spurns a great opportunity from inside the 6-yard box. The ball flies narrowly wide of the left post.
66' Matteo Politano (Napoli) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar.
65' A pass from Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) is intercepted by Maduka Okoye and the move breaks down.
64' After VAR review the ref signals the yellow card is cancelled but now issues a red. Christian Kabasele (Udinese) has to leave the pitch!

63' There's a break in play and the referee must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier infringement by Christian Kabasele (Udinese) using VAR. This could result in a red card!
62' The foul by Christian Kabasele (Udinese) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Andrea Zanotti.
61' Scott McTominay (Napoli) produces a long-range volley, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.
59' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Adam Buksa (Udinese) is coming onto the pitch as Jesper Karlstrom cannot continue after picking up an injury.
59' Kosta Runjaic has decided to substitute Thomas Kristensen and he is replaced by Nicolo Bertola (Udinese).
59' Matteo Politano (Napoli) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
58' Wonderful movement by Napoli. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
54' Substitution. Jakub Piotrowski leaves the pitch and is replaced by Idrissa Gueye (Udinese).
53' The ball rebounds out to Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar.
51' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) was quite harsh and Andrea Zanotti didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
49' Billy Gilmour (Napoli) sends a long ball in, but Maduka Okoye comfortably gathers the ball.
46' Antonio Conte makes a switch. Juan Jesus (Napoli) is coming on in place of Mathias Olivera at the start of the second period.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Keinan Davis (Udinese) plays a through ball but overhits it.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Matteo Politano (Napoli) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

45' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli), but the defence gets it clear. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Napoli.
44' Matteo Politano (Napoli) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
41' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
37' Antonio Conte is forced to make a change. Stanislav Lobotka is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Billy Gilmour (Napoli).
36' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
35' The goalkeeper pulls off a save to deny Arthur Atta (Udinese), whose low effort is only aimed at the middle of the goal.
34' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
32' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
27' Scott McTominay (Napoli) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar.
24' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! Kevin De Bruyne laid the ball off to Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli), who shot from close range into the bottom left corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
23' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires well wide of the left post.
23' Matteo Politano (Napoli) plays a through ball but overhits it.
22' Matteo Politano (Napoli) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
20' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar.
15' Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) gets to the rebound on the edge of the penalty area and fires a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Alex Meret gets a hand to it and keeps it out.
14' Lennon Miller (Udinese) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
13' Keinan Davis (Udinese) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. Udinese have been awarded a corner kick.
13' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
10' Alisson Santos (Napoli) is substituted due to injury. Antonio Conte gives a chance to Kevin De Bruyne.
8' The game is interrupted now, Alisson Santos (Napoli) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
6' Keinan Davis (Udinese) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
4' Flag goes up against Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
3' Matteo Politano (Napoli) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
2' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Matteo Politano (Napoli), but one of the defenders gets it clear. Napoli force a corner. They send men into the box.

2' Alisson Santos (Napoli) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Maduka Okoye inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball into the bottom right corner, but was denied by a great save. Napoli get a corner.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Udinese will have the kick-off.
